controlContract.emptyBehavior: retain owner, stop scoring, decay unfinished capture by one sixth per second
controlContract.ownerReturnBehavior: uncontested owner clears hostile unfinished capture and resumes scoring
controlContract.eligibleOccupants: connected living hero, respawn <= 0, finite height <= 2 m, inside inclusive radius; exclude summons
